cond_0001.intro:
This position is an integral member of the Global Shared Services Local Applications and e-PMO Team and is primarily responsible for supporting a variety of manufacturing and business applications as well as reporting and Business Intelligence initiatives. The successful candidate will demonstrate technical aptitude, enthusiasm and communication skills to function as both business analyst and technologist. Key aspects of the role include:
Leveraging strong functional, operational knowledge of the related business processes involved in local applications to support end-user use of the system, and perform diagnoses of system issues.
Supporting major projects, working with corresponding cross functional business departments and with management to understand functional and business roadmap deployment schedules.
Working closely with various business partners including Global Process Owners, Business Process Engineers and IT peers to help define and test solutions in support of prioritized business initiatives.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Manage and contribute to delivery and quality of local applications. This includes requirements, technical design/build/test/optimize activities.
Perform ETL and data warehouse design/build/test/optimize activities.
Candidate will have practical experience through full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support and optimization.
Understand new business strategies, and provide recommendations for automated solutions to support new strategies and implement proposed solutions with available resources and timelines.
Experience in preparing data and constructing advanced data visualization dashboard style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Must have strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills.
Work closely with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements with the system and recommend and develop specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures and use standard procedures and practices in performing the required work.
Must be flexible to change, able to multi-task and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.
Participate in on-call rotating requirement shared with team.
Provide incident ticket and on call support resolution for related requests.
Continuously enhance skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Work in conjunction with users, business analysts and external resources to define system objectives and requirements, and execute according to plan; produce and maintain detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Perform maintenance and enhancements for existing systems applications, correct problems and revise systems as business requirements dictate, including analysis, design and development for requested changes and improvements.
Assist in the translation of business requirements and project scope into solutions in collaboration with both internal and external team members and business stakeholders.
Work collaboratively with business partners to help identify opportunities to streamline or automate their operations.
Manage multiple priorities to maintain a balance between day to day operations, projects and strategic development and to ensure deadlines are met.
Ability to perform first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Help ensure data remains complete, accurate and valid during its input, update and storage.
Support and align with global IT vision, ensure that IT activities support global vision.
Participate in global meetings to review application performance and project status.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience collaborating with internal IT teams to define and design application solutions that meet the customer needs and IT best practices.
Experience with MS SQL, C#, C/C++, .NET or JavaScript.
Experience using back-end and front-end languages to develop complete solutions.
Strong analytical and design experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Analytical problem solver, sense of urgency, proactive to issues.
Demonstrated strong interpersonal, team and verbal/written communication skills.
Excellent communication, problem solving, and customer service skills.
The ability to express complex concepts effectively to the business, yet technical enough to have a detailed review of designs and approaches with technical resources.
The ability to work well with people from many different disciplines and cultures with varying degrees of IT experience.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow or Google Cloud Storage a plus.
Readiness for further education in new languages and technologies.
Ability to work in a demanding position, balancing diverse priorities.
Ability to work in an independent self-directed manner while engaging fully as part of a global team of professionals.
Experience in working within international teams an added advantage.

The successful candidate will demonstrate technical aptitude, enthusiasm and communication skills to function as both business analyst and technologist. Key aspects of the role include:
Leveraging strong functional, operational knowledge of the related business processes involved in local applications to support end-user use of the system, and perform diagnoses of system issues.
Supporting major projects, working with corresponding cross functional business departments and with management to understand functional and business roadmap deployment schedules.
Working closely with various business partners including Global Process Owners, Business Process Engineers and IT peers to help define and test solutions in support of prioritized business initiatives.
Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience across the development and support cycle.
cond_0023.responsibilities:
Manage and contribute to delivery and quality of local applications. This includes requirements, technical design/build/test/optimize activities.
Perform ETL and data warehouse design/build/test/optimize activities.
Candidate will have practical experience through full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support and optimization.
Understand new business strategies, and provide recommendations for automated solutions to support new strategies and implement proposed solutions with available resources and timelines.
Experience in preparing data and constructing advanced data visualization dashboard style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Must have strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills.
Work closely with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements with the system and recommend and develop specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures and use standard procedures and practices in performing the required work.
Must be flexible to change, able to multi-task and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.
Participate in on-call rotating requirement shared with team.
Provide incident ticket and on call support resolution for related requests.
Continuously enhance skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Work in conjunction with users, business analysts and external resources to define system objectives and requirements, and execute according to plan; produce and maintain detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Perform maintenance and enhancements for existing systems applications, correct problems and revise systems as business requirements dictate, including analysis, design and development for requested changes and improvements.
Assist in the translation of business requirements and project scope into solutions in collaboration with both internal and external team members and business stakeholders.
Work collaboratively with business partners to help identify opportunities to streamline or automate their operations.
Manage multiple priorities to maintain a balance between day to day operations, projects and strategic development and to ensure deadlines are met.
Ability to perform first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Help ensure data remains complete, accurate and valid during its input, update and storage.
Support and align with global IT vision, ensure that IT activities support global vision.
Participate in global meetings to review application performance and project status.
cond_0023.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience collaborating with internal IT teams to define and design application solutions that meet the customer needs and IT best practices.
Experience with MS SQL, C#, C/C++, .NET or JavaScript.
Experience using back-end and front-end languages to develop complete solutions.
Strong analytical and design experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Analytical problem solver, sense of urgency, proactive to issues.
Demonstrated strong interpersonal, team and verbal/written communication skills.
Excellent communication, problem solving, and customer service skills.
The ability to express complex concepts effectively to the business, yet technical enough to have a detailed review of designs and approaches with technical resources.
The ability to work well with people from many different disciplines and cultures with varying degrees of IT experience.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow or Google Cloud Storage.
Readiness for further education in new languages and technologies.
Ability to work in a demanding position, balancing diverse priorities.
Ability to work in an independent self-directed manner while engaging fully as part of a global team of professionals.
Experience in working within international teams.

cond_0045.intro:
This position is part of the Global Shared Services Local Applications and e-PMO Team and works alongside colleagues to support a variety of manufacturing and business applications, as well as reporting and Business Intelligence initiatives. The successful candidate will bring technical skills, enthusiasm, and communication ability to contribute as both business analyst and technologist. Key aspects of the role include:
Working with strong functional knowledge of related business processes to support end-user use of the system and help diagnose system issues.
Supporting major projects in coordination with cross-functional business departments and management to understand functional and business roadmap deployment schedules.
Partnering closely with Global Process Owners, Business Process Engineers, and IT peers to help define and test solutions in support of prioritized business initiatives.
cond_0045.responsibilities:
Coordinate with team members to deliver and maintain quality of local applications, including requirements, technical design, build, test, and optimization activities.
Work alongside colleagues on ETL and data warehouse design, build, test, and optimization activities.
Contribute through the full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support, and optimization.
Work with business partners to understand new strategies and jointly develop recommendations for automated solutions, then help implement those solutions within available resources and timelines.
Collaborate on preparing data and building advanced data visualization dashboard-style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills are needed.
Work closely with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements, then jointly recommend and develop specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures, and standard practices in performing the required work.
Stay flexible and responsive to shifting priorities while supporting the broader team.
Share in on-call rotating requirements with the team.
Help resolve incident tickets and on-call support requests for related issues.
Continuously build skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Work together with users, business analysts, and external resources to define system objectives and requirements, and contribute to detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs, and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Support maintenance and enhancements for existing systems, correct problems, and help revise systems as business requirements change, including analysis, design, and development for requested improvements.
Help translate business requirements and project scope into solutions in coordination with internal and external team members and business stakeholders.
Work with business partners to help identify opportunities to streamline or automate their operations.
Coordinate across multiple priorities to balance day-to-day operations, projects, and strategic development and help ensure deadlines are met.
Assist with first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Help troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Help ensure data remains complete, accurate, and valid during input, update, and storage.
Support and align with global IT vision, ensuring that IT activities support that shared direction.
Participate in global meetings to review application performance and project status.
cond_0045.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience collaborating with internal IT teams to define and design application solutions that meet customer needs and IT best practices.
Experience with MS SQL, C#, C/C++, .NET, or JavaScript.
Experience using back-end and front-end languages to develop complete solutions.
Strong analytical and design experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Analytical problem solver with a sense of urgency and a proactive approach to issues.
Demonstrated strong interpersonal, team, and verbal/written communication skills.
Ability to express complex concepts clearly to business stakeholders while also engaging at a technical level with technical resources.
Ability to work well with people from different disciplines and cultures with varying degrees of IT experience.
Excellent communication, problem solving, and customer service skills.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow, or Google Cloud Storage experience.
Readiness for further education in new languages and technologies.
Ability to work independently in a self-directed manner while engaging fully as part of a global team.
Experience working within international teams.

This position is an integral member of the Global Shared Services Local Applications and e-PMO Team and is primarily responsible for supporting a variety of manufacturing and business applications as well as reporting and Business Intelligence initiatives. The successful candidate will demonstrate technical aptitude, enthusiasm and communication skills to function as both business analyst and technologist. Key aspects of the role include:
Leveraging strong functional, operational knowledge of the related business processes involved in local applications to support end-user use of the system, and perform diagnoses of system issues.
Supporting major projects, working with corresponding cross functional business departments and with management to understand functional and business roadmap deployment schedules.
Working closely with various business partners including Global Process Owners, Business Process Engineers and IT peers to help define and test solutions in support of prioritized business initiatives.
Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience across the development and support cycle.
cond_0059.responsibilities:
Manage and contribute to delivery and quality of local applications. This includes requirements, technical design/build/test/optimize activities.
Perform ETL and data warehouse design/build/test/optimize activities.
Candidate will have practical experience through full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support and optimization.
Understand new business strategies, and provide recommendations for automated solutions to support new strategies and implement proposed solutions with available resources and timelines.
Experience in preparing data and constructing advanced data visualization dashboard style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Must have strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills.
Work closely with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements with the system and recommend and develop specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures and use standard procedures and practices in performing the required work.
Must be flexible to change, able to multi-task and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.
Participate in on-call rotating requirement shared with team.
Provide incident ticket and on call support resolution for related requests.
Continuously enhance skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Work in conjunction with users, business analysts and external resources to define system objectives and requirements, and execute according to plan; produce and maintain detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Perform maintenance and enhancements for existing systems applications, correct problems and revise systems as business requirements dictate, including analysis, design and development for requested changes and improvements.
Assist in the translation of business requirements and project scope into solutions in collaboration with both internal and external team members and business stakeholders.
Work collaboratively with business partners to help identify opportunities to streamline or automate their operations.
Manage multiple priorities to maintain a balance between day to day operations, projects and strategic development and to ensure deadlines are met.
Ability to perform first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Help ensure data remains complete, accurate and valid during its input, update and storage.
Support and align with global IT vision, ensure that IT activities support global vision.
Participate in global meetings to review application performance and project status.
cond_0059.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience collaborating with internal IT teams to define and design application solutions that meet the customer needs and IT best practices.
Experience with MS SQL, C#, C/C++, .NET or JavaScript.
Experience using back-end and front-end languages to develop complete solutions.
Strong analytical and design experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Analytical problem solver, sense of urgency, proactive to issues.
Demonstrated strong interpersonal, team and verbal/written communication skills.
Excellent communication, problem solving, and customer service skills.
The ability to express complex concepts effectively to the business, yet technical enough to have a detailed review of designs and approaches with technical resources.
The ability to work well with people from many different disciplines and cultures with varying degrees of IT experience.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow or Google Cloud Storage.
Readiness for further education in new languages and technologies.
Ability to work in a demanding position, balancing diverse priorities.
Ability to work in an independent self-directed manner while engaging fully as part of a global team of professionals.
Experience in working within international teams.

This role sits within the Global Shared Services Local Applications and e-PMO Team and is primarily responsible for supporting a variety of manufacturing and business applications as well as reporting and Business Intelligence initiatives. The role involves regular contact with business partners, end users, and IT peers, and requires someone who can work as both a business analyst and a technologist. Key aspects of the role include:
Staying closely connected with business processes in local applications to support end-user use of the system and diagnose system issues.
Supporting major projects, working directly with cross-functional business departments and management to understand functional and business roadmap deployment schedules.
Working closely with Global Process Owners, Business Process Engineers, and IT peers on a regular basis to help define and test solutions in support of prioritized business initiatives.
cond_0150.responsibilities:
Manage and contribute to delivery and quality of local applications, including requirements, technical design, build, test, and optimize activities.
Perform ETL and data warehouse design, build, test, and optimize activities.
Apply hands-on experience through the full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support, and optimization.
Understand new business strategies and actively discuss recommendations for automated solutions with stakeholders to support new strategies; implement proposed solutions within available resources and timelines.
Prepare data and build advanced data visualization dashboard-style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills are required.
Stay in regular contact with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements, then recommend and develop specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures, and standard practices in performing the required work.
Remain flexible to change, able to multi-task, and adapt to shifting priorities.
Participate in on-call rotating requirement shared with the team.
Provide incident ticket and on-call support resolution for related requests.
Continuously build skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Work directly with users, business analysts, and external resources to clarify system objectives and requirements, and execute according to plan; produce and maintain detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs, and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Perform maintenance and enhancements for existing systems, correct problems, and revise systems as business requirements change, including analysis, design, and development for requested changes and improvements.
Actively contribute to translating business requirements and project scope into solutions, working alongside both internal and external team members and business stakeholders.
Work closely with business partners to identify opportunities to streamline or automate their operations.
Manage multiple priorities to balance day-to-day operations, projects, and strategic development, and ensure deadlines are met.
Perform first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Help ensure data remains complete, accurate, and valid during input, update, and storage.
Support and align with global IT vision; ensure that IT activities support that vision.
Participate in global meetings to review application performance and project status, contributing actively to discussions.
cond_0150.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience collaborating with internal IT teams to define and design application solutions that meet customer needs and IT best practices.
Experience with MS SQL, C#, C/C++, .NET, or JavaScript.
Experience using back-end and front-end languages to develop complete solutions.
Strong analytical and design experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Demonstrated strong interpersonal, team, and verbal/written communication skills.
Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to business stakeholders while also engaging in detailed technical design reviews with technical resources.
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and customer service skills.
Ability to work independently and in a self-directed manner while engaging fully as part of a global team.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow, or Google Cloud Storage experience.
Experience working within international teams.
Readiness to continue learning new languages and technologies.
Ability to work well with people from many different disciplines and cultures with varying degrees of IT experience.
cond_0150.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0150.values: We value acting with integrity and keeping the interests of others in view. We aim to create positive outcomes through work that is respectful, fair, and responsible.

Manage and contribute to delivery and quality of local applications. This includes requirements, technical design/build/test/optimize activities.
Perform ETL and data warehouse design/build/test/optimize activities.
Candidate will have practical experience through full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support and optimization.
Understand new business strategies, and provide recommendations for automated solutions to support new strategies and implement proposed solutions with available resources and timelines.
Experience in preparing data and constructing advanced data visualization dashboard style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Must have strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills.
Work closely with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements with the system and recommend and develop specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures and use standard procedures and practices in performing the required work.
Must be flexible to change, able to multi-task and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.
Participate in on-call rotating requirement shared with team.
Provide incident ticket and on call support resolution for related requests.
Continuously enhance skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Work in conjunction with users, business analysts and external resources to define system objectives and requirements, and execute according to plan; produce and maintain detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Perform maintenance and enhancements for existing systems applications, correct problems and revise systems as business requirements dictate, including analysis, design and development for requested changes and improvements.
Assist in the translation of business requirements and project scope into solutions in collaboration with both internal and external team members and business stakeholders.
Work collaboratively with business partners to help identify opportunities to streamline or automate their operations.
Manage multiple priorities to maintain a balance between day to day operations, projects and strategic development and to ensure deadlines are met.
Ability to perform first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Help ensure data remains complete, accurate and valid during its input, update and storage.
Support and align with global IT vision, ensure that IT activities support global vision.
Participate in global meetings to review application performance and project status.
cond_0227.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise collaborating with internal IT teams to define and design application solutions that meet customer needs and IT best practices.
Deep knowledge of MS SQL, C#, C/C++, .NET or JavaScript.
Strong command of back-end and front-end languages to develop complete solutions.
Extensive analytical and design expertise.
Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite.
Proficiency in Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow or Google Cloud Storage a plus.
Proven track record as an analytical problem solver, with a strong sense of urgency and a proactive approach to issues.
Readiness for further education in new languages and technologies.
Ability to work in a demanding position, balancing diverse priorities.
Exceptional interpersonal, team, and verbal/written communication skills.
Ability to work in an independent self-directed manner while engaging fully as part of a global team of professionals.
Substantial experience working within international teams an added advantage.
Exceptional communication, problem solving, and customer service skills are essential.
Advanced ability to express complex concepts effectively to the business, yet technical enough to conduct detailed reviews of designs and approaches with technical resources.
Proven ability to work effectively with people from many different disciplines and cultures with varying degrees of IT experience.
cond_0227.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

This position is an integral member of the [Company name masked] Global Shared Services Local Applications and e-PMO Team and is primarily responsible for supporting a variety of manufacturing and business applications as well as reporting and Business Intelligence initiatives. The successful candidate will demonstrate technical aptitude, enthusiasm and communication skills to function as both business analyst and technologist. Key aspects of the role include:
Leveraging strong functional, operational knowledge of the related business processes involved in local applications to support end-user use of the system, and perform diagnoses of system issues.
Supporting major projects, working with corresponding cross functional business departments and with management to understand functional and business roadmap deployment schedules.
Working closely with various business partners including Global Process Owners, Business Process Engineers and IT peers to help define and test solutions in support of prioritized business initiatives.
cond_0300.responsibilities:
Manage and contribute to delivery and quality of local applications. This includes requirements, technical design/build/test/optimize activities.
Perform ETL and data warehouse design/build/test/optimize activities.
Candidate will have practical experience through full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support and optimization.
Understand new business strategies, and provide recommendations for automated solutions to support new strategies and implement proposed solutions with available resources and timelines.
Experience in preparing data and constructing advanced data visualization dashboard style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Must have strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills.
Work closely with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements with the system and recommend and develop specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures and use standard procedures and practices in performing the required work.
Must be flexible to change, able to multi-task and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.
Participate in on-call rotating requirement shared with team.
Provide incident ticket and on call support resolution for related requests.
Continuously enhance skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Work in conjunction with users, business analysts and external resources to define system objectives and requirements, and execute according to plan; produce and maintain detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Perform maintenance and enhancements for existing systems applications, correct problems and revise systems as business requirements dictate, including analysis, design and development for requested changes and improvements.
Assist in the translation of business requirements and project scope into solutions in collaboration with both internal and external team members and business stakeholders.
Work collaboratively with business partners to help identify opportunities to streamline or automate their operations.
Manage multiple priorities to maintain a balance between day to day operations, projects and strategic development and to ensure deadlines are met.
Ability to perform first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Help ensure data remains complete, accurate and valid during its input, update and storage.
Support and align with global IT vision, ensure that IT activities support global vision.
Participate in global meetings to review application performance and project status.
cond_0300.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience collaborating with internal IT teams to define and design application solutions that meet customer needs and IT best practices.
Working knowledge of MS SQL, C#, C/C++, .NET or JavaScript.
Experience using back-end and front-end languages to develop complete solutions.
Some background in analytical and design work.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite.
Exposure to Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow or Google Cloud Storage is a plus.
Ability to approach problems analytically, with a willingness to act on issues proactively.
Openness to learning new languages and technologies as the role evolves.
Ability to balance diverse priorities in a demanding position.
Ability to communicate effectively with team members, both verbally and in writing, and to work well within a team.
Ability to work independently while engaging fully as part of a global team.
Experience working within international teams is an added advantage.
Ability to communicate clearly, solve problems, and support customers — these are important to the role.
Comfort expressing complex concepts to business stakeholders, while also being able to engage technically with developers and architects.
Willingness to work with people from many different disciplines and cultures with varying degrees of IT experience.
cond_0300.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

The successful candidate will demonstrate technical aptitude, enthusiasm and communication skills to function as both business analyst and technologist. Key aspects of the role include:
Leveraging strong functional, operational knowledge of the related business processes involved in local applications to support end-user use of the system, and perform diagnoses of system issues.
Supporting major projects, working with corresponding cross functional business departments and with management to understand functional and business roadmap deployment schedules.
Working closely with various business partners including Global Process Owners, Business Process Engineers and IT peers to help define and test solutions in support of prioritized business initiatives.
cond_0354.responsibilities:
Manage and contribute to delivery and quality of local applications. This includes requirements, technical design/build/test/optimize activities.
Perform ETL and data warehouse design/build/test/optimize activities.
Candidate will have practical experience through full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support and optimization.
Understand new business strategies, and provide recommendations for automated solutions to support new strategies and implement proposed solutions with available resources and timelines.
Experience in preparing data and constructing advanced data visualization dashboard style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Must have strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills.
Work closely with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements with the system and recommend and develop specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures and use standard procedures and practices in performing the required work.
Must be flexible to change, able to multi-task and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.
Participate in on-call rotating requirement shared with team.
Provide incident ticket and on call support resolution for related requests.
Continuously enhance skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Work in conjunction with users, business analysts and external resources to define system objectives and requirements, and execute according to plan; produce and maintain detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Perform maintenance and enhancements for existing systems applications, correct problems and revise systems as business requirements dictate, including analysis, design and development for requested changes and improvements.
Assist in the translation of business requirements and project scope into solutions in collaboration with both internal and external team members and business stakeholders.
Work collaboratively with business partners to help identify opportunities to streamline or automate their operations.
Manage multiple priorities to maintain a balance between day to day operations, projects and strategic development and to ensure deadlines are met.
Ability to perform first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Help ensure data remains complete, accurate and valid during its input, update and storage.
Support and align with global IT vision, ensure that IT activities support global vision.
Participate in global meetings to review application performance and project status.
cond_0354.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience collaborating with internal IT teams to define and design application solutions that meet customer needs and IT best practices.
Working knowledge of MS SQL, C#, C/C++, .NET or JavaScript.
Experience using back-end and front-end languages to develop complete solutions.
Some background in analytical and design work.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite.
Exposure to Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow or Google Cloud Storage is a plus.
Ability to approach problems analytically, with a willingness to act on issues proactively.
Openness to learning new languages and technologies as the role evolves.
Ability to balance diverse priorities in a demanding position.
Ability to communicate effectively with team members, both verbally and in writing, and to work well within a team.
Ability to work independently while engaging fully as part of a global team.
Experience working within international teams is an added advantage.
Ability to communicate clearly, solve problems, and support customers — these are important to the role.
Comfort expressing complex concepts to business stakeholders, while also being able to engage technically with developers and architects.
Willingness to work with people from many different disciplines and cultures with varying degrees of IT experience.
cond_0354.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.
cond_0354.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

The successful candidate will bring technical skills, enthusiasm, and communication ability to contribute as both business analyst and technologist. Key aspects of the role include:
Working with strong functional knowledge of related business processes to support end-user use of the system and help diagnose system issues.
Supporting major projects in coordination with cross-functional business departments and management to understand functional and business roadmap deployment schedules.
Partnering closely with Global Process Owners, Business Process Engineers, and IT peers to help define and test solutions in support of prioritized business initiatives.
cond_0423.responsibilities:
Coordinate with team members to deliver and maintain quality of local applications, including requirements, technical design, build, test, and optimization activities.
Work alongside colleagues on ETL and data warehouse design, build, test, and optimization activities.
Contribute through the full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support, and optimization.
Work with business partners to understand new strategies and jointly develop recommendations for automated solutions, then help implement those solutions within available resources and timelines.
Collaborate on preparing data and building advanced data visualization dashboard-style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills are needed.
Work closely with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements, then jointly recommend and develop specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures, and standard practices in performing the required work.
Stay flexible and responsive to shifting priorities while supporting the broader team.
Share in on-call rotating requirements with the team.
Help resolve incident tickets and on-call support requests for related issues.
Continuously build skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Work together with users, business analysts, and external resources to define system objectives and requirements, and contribute to detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs, and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Support maintenance and enhancements for existing systems, correct problems, and help revise systems as business requirements change, including analysis, design, and development for requested improvements.
Help translate business requirements and project scope into solutions in coordination with internal and external team members and business stakeholders.
Work with business partners to help identify opportunities to streamline or automate their operations.
Coordinate across multiple priorities to balance day-to-day operations, projects, and strategic development and help ensure deadlines are met.
Assist with first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Help troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Help ensure data remains complete, accurate, and valid during input, update, and storage.
Support and align with global IT vision, ensuring that IT activities support that shared direction.
Participate in global meetings to review application performance and project status.
cond_0423.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience collaborating with internal IT teams to define and design application solutions that meet customer needs and IT best practices.
Experience with MS SQL, C#, C/C++, .NET, or JavaScript.
Experience using back-end and front-end languages to develop complete solutions.
Strong analytical and design experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Analytical problem solver with a sense of urgency and a proactive approach to issues.
Demonstrated strong interpersonal, team, and verbal/written communication skills.
Ability to express complex concepts clearly to business stakeholders while also engaging at a technical level with technical resources.
Ability to work well with people from different disciplines and cultures with varying degrees of IT experience.
Excellent communication, problem solving, and customer service skills.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow, or Google Cloud Storage experience.
Readiness for further education in new languages and technologies.
Ability to work independently in a self-directed manner while engaging fully as part of a global team.
Experience working within international teams.
cond_0423.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.

This position is an integral member of the Global Shared Services Local Applications and e-PMO Team and is primarily responsible for supporting a variety of manufacturing and business applications as well as reporting and Business Intelligence initiatives. The successful candidate will demonstrate technical aptitude, enthusiasm and communication skills to function as both business analyst and technologist. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of data systems and the business processes behind them. Key aspects of the role include:
Leveraging strong functional, operational knowledge of the related business processes involved in local applications to support end-user use of the system, and perform diagnoses of system issues.
Supporting major projects, working with corresponding cross functional business departments and with management to understand functional and business roadmap deployment schedules.
Working closely with various business partners including Global Process Owners, Business Process Engineers and IT peers to help define and test solutions in support of prioritized business initiatives.
cond_0454.responsibilities:
Manage and contribute to delivery and quality of local applications. This includes requirements, technical design/build/test/optimize activities.
Perform ETL and data warehouse design/build/test/optimize activities.
Candidate will have practical experience through full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support and optimization.
Understand new business strategies, and provide recommendations for automated solutions to support new strategies and implement proposed solutions with available resources and timelines.
Experience in preparing data and constructing advanced data visualization dashboard style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Must have strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills.
Work closely with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements with the system and recommend and develop specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures and use standard procedures and practices in performing the required work.
Must be flexible to change, able to multi-task and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.
Participate in on-call rotating requirement shared with team.
Provide incident ticket and on call support resolution for related requests.
Continuously enhance skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Work in conjunction with users, business analysts and external resources to define system objectives and requirements, and execute according to plan; produce and maintain detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Perform maintenance and enhancements for existing systems applications, correct problems and revise systems as business requirements dictate, including analysis, design and development for requested changes and improvements.
Assist in the translation of business requirements and project scope into solutions in collaboration with both internal and external team members and business stakeholders.
Work collaboratively with business partners to help identify opportunities to streamline or automate their operations.
Manage multiple priorities to maintain a balance between day to day operations, projects and strategic development and to ensure deadlines are met.
Ability to perform first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Help ensure data remains complete, accurate and valid during its input, update and storage.
Support and align with global IT vision, ensure that IT activities support global vision.
Participate in global meetings to review application performance and project status.
cond_0454.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience collaborating with internal IT teams to define and design application solutions that meet the customer needs and IT best practices.
Experience with MS SQL, C#, C/C++, .NET or JavaScript.
Experience using back-end and front-end languages to develop complete solutions.
Strong analytical and design experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Analytical problem solver, sense of urgency, proactive to issues.
Demonstrated strong interpersonal, team and verbal/written communication skills.
Excellent communication, problem solving, and customer service skills.
The ability to express complex concepts effectively to the business, yet technical enough to have a detailed review of designs and approaches with technical resources.
The ability to work well with people from many different disciplines and cultures with varying degrees of IT experience.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow or Google Cloud Storage.
Readiness for further education in new languages and technologies.
Ability to work in a demanding position, balancing diverse priorities.
Ability to work in an independent self-directed manner while engaging fully as part of a global team of professionals.
Experience in working within international teams.

The role is primarily accountable for a variety of manufacturing and business applications, as well as reporting and Business Intelligence initiatives. The successful candidate will demonstrate technical aptitude, enthusiasm, and communication skills to function as both business analyst and technologist. Key aspects of the role include:
Leveraging strong functional, operational knowledge of related business processes to direct end-user use of the system and execute diagnoses of system issues.
Leading support for major projects, engaging cross-functional business departments and management to drive understanding of functional and business roadmap deployment schedules.
Working closely with various business partners including Global Process Owners, Business Process Engineers, and IT peers to define and deliver solutions in support of prioritized business initiatives.
cond_0593.responsibilities:
Own delivery and quality of local applications, including requirements, technical design, build, test, and optimize activities.
Execute ETL and data warehouse design, build, test, and optimize activities.
Apply practical experience through the full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support, and optimization.
Assess new business strategies and determine recommendations for automated solutions, then implement proposed solutions within available resources and timelines.
Lead the preparation of data and construction of advanced data visualization dashboard-style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Must have strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills.
Engage directly with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements, then develop specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures, and standard practices in performing the required work.
Manage shifting priorities and adapt quickly to change while handling multiple tasks.
Take ownership of on-call rotating requirements shared with the team.
Resolve incident tickets and on-call support requests.
Continuously build skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Define system objectives and requirements in conjunction with users, business analysts, and external resources; execute according to plan and produce and maintain detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs, and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Drive maintenance and enhancements for existing systems, correct problems, and revise systems as business requirements dictate, including analysis, design, and development for requested changes and improvements.
Lead the translation of business requirements and project scope into solutions in collaboration with internal and external team members and business stakeholders.
Identify opportunities to streamline or automate business partner operations.
Manage multiple priorities to maintain a balance between day-to-day operations, projects, and strategic development, ensuring deadlines are met.
Perform first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Ensure data remains complete, accurate, and valid during input, update, and storage.
Align with global IT vision and ensure that IT activities support that vision.
Lead participation in global meetings to review application performance and project status.
cond_0593.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field preferred.
Experience collaborating with internal IT teams to define and design application solutions that meet customer needs and IT best practices.
Experience with MS SQL, C#, C/C++, .NET or JavaScript.
Experience using back-end and front-end languages to develop complete solutions.
Strong analytical and design experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow or Google Cloud Storage a plus.
Analytical problem solver, sense of urgency, proactive to issues.
Readiness for further education in new languages and technologies.
Ability to work in a demanding position, balancing diverse priorities.
Demonstrated strong interpersonal, team and verbal/written communication skills.
Ability to work in an independent self-directed manner while engaging fully as part of a global team of professionals.
Experience in working within international teams an added advantage.
Excellent communication, problem solving, and customer service skills are essential.
The ability to express complex concepts effectively to the business, yet technical enough to have a detailed review of designs and approaches with technical resources.
The ability to work well with people from many different disciplines and cultures with varying degrees of IT experience.

cond_0609.intro:
We are looking for an IT Systems Developer/Analyst to join our team. This role sits within the Global Shared Services Local Applications and e-PMO Team and is primarily responsible for supporting a variety of manufacturing and business applications as well as reporting and Business Intelligence initiatives. The role involves regular contact with business partners, end users, and IT peers, and requires someone who can work as both a business analyst and a technologist. Key aspects of the role include:
Staying closely connected with business processes in local applications to support end-user use of the system and diagnose system issues on an ongoing basis.
Supporting major projects, working directly with cross-functional business departments and management to understand functional and business roadmap deployment schedules.
Collaborating daily with various business partners including Global Process Owners, Business Process Engineers, and IT peers to help define and test solutions in support of prioritized business initiatives.
cond_0609.responsibilities:
Manage and contribute to delivery and quality of local applications. This includes requirements, technical design/build/test/optimize activities.
Perform ETL and data warehouse design/build/test/optimize activities.
Apply practical experience through the full development cycle of enterprise data warehouse construction, support, and optimization.
Understand new business strategies, and communicate recommendations for automated solutions to support new strategies; implement proposed solutions with available resources and timelines.
Prepare data and construct advanced data visualization dashboard style reporting in Business Objects, Tableau, or Looker. Must have strong ETL (Business Objects Data Services) skills.
Work closely and regularly with business process engineers to understand problems and requirements, then actively contribute specifications to resolve them.
Follow integration testing procedures, change control procedures, and use standard procedures and practices in performing the required work.
Stay flexible and responsive to shifting priorities while managing multiple tasks.
Participate in on-call rotating requirement shared with team.
Provide incident ticket and on-call support resolution for related requests, communicating clearly with users throughout.
Continuously enhance skills and knowledge through research, training, and other methods.
Work directly with users, business analysts, and external resources to clarify system objectives and requirements, and execute according to plan; produce and maintain detailed specifications for applications, including architecture, designs, and interfaces between corporate systems as required.
Perform maintenance and enhancements for existing systems applications, correct problems, and revise systems as business requirements dictate, including analysis, design, and development for requested changes and improvements.
Actively engage with both internal and external team members and business stakeholders to translate business requirements and project scope into solutions.
Work collaboratively with business partners on a regular basis to help identify opportunities to streamline or automate their operations.
Manage multiple priorities to maintain a balance between day-to-day operations, projects, and strategic development, and to ensure deadlines are met.
Perform first-level debugging of systems to analyze and resolve issues.
Troubleshoot and triage problem reports, resolve, and escalate as required.
Help ensure data remains complete, accurate, and valid during its input, update, and storage.
Support and align with global IT vision; ensure that IT activities support global vision.
Participate in global meetings to review application performance and project status, contributing actively to discussions.
